evidence.author: Alex Gassman
evidence.observation: Opened body explicitly describes E as formerly M and says an older M viewing video shows the same location. This is a travel guide, not annual promoter inventory.
evidence.limitations: The same page describes rows A–K and seats1–30, then later mentions row M and seats40; internal inconsistencies preclude using it as a measured seat plan or sole identity authority. Publication update does not establish when any renaming occurred.

officialEvidenceAlreadyHeld.observation: Final2026 public legend names E but not M. Absence alone does not establish renaming, cancellation or exclusivity.

decision: Withdraw unverified legacy shape from current runtime; retain complete candidate off-runtime. No positive independent2026M product found. Does not prove cancellation or accept M-to-E alias.
nextAction: If a positive2026M ticket/organizer crosswalk appears, re-evaluate archived candidate; do not render a known conflicting unknown polygon meanwhile.
